# Ember

Ember applies a low-glare interface with a charred near-black dark mode, a warm parchment light mode and ember-orange accents. The recorded description says the theme falls back to the system font stack so it runs offline, and that three recommended free fonts can be installed to match the typography it was designed for.

![Ember screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rhydlewis/obsidian-ember/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Ember"
    author: "Rhyd Lewis"
    repo:   "rhydlewis/obsidian-ember"
    slug:   "ember"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ember"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/rhydlewis/obsidian-ember"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rhydlewis/obsidian-ember/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a warm, low-glare UI with charred near-black dark mode, warm parchment light mode, and ember-orange accents. Use your system font stack for offline operation or install the three recommended free fonts to match the theme’s intended typography."
}
```
